title: Building a Linux GPU Driver for the M4 Mac Mini in One Month
summary: A developer documented their journey of building a Linux GPU driver for the M4 Mac Mini in one month, involving reverse engineering of Apple's proprietary AGX GPU architecture to enable GPU acceleration on Apple Silicon hardware under Linux.
problem_solved: Enables GPU acceleration support for M4 Mac Mini's Apple Silicon GPU under Linux, which currently lacks native driver support.
why_valuable: This project advances Linux support for Apple Silicon hardware and provides valuable insights into reverse engineering proprietary GPU architectures for the open-source community.
